notes:
Lead background: BrightSail Answers operates a small ecommerce chat/support widget used on their storefront. Came in via free signup; heavy focus on fast reply times for checkout-touch flows. They are price conscious and want to keep everything on hosted API (public cloud).

Customer-reported symptoms (from email & call):
- "Perceived slowness" when customers ask shipping/checkout questions; internal timing shows p95 ~800-1,200ms for single-turn chat requests.
- Timeouts in their frontend at 1.0s cause degraded UX; they sometimes hit client-side 504s.
- Variance by region: EU users saw worse median latency vs NA.

What we verified / recommended so far:
- Region choice: suggested NA region for US-heavy traffic; recommended EU region only if majority users there. Proposed quick A/B: route small % to NA vs EU to compare p50/p95 and egress costs.
- Model selection: suggested trying a smaller, lower-latency model for short support Q/A (e.g., 3-7B equivalent) and reserve larger models for long-form summarization.
- Prompt guidance: shorten system + user prompt, prefer structured templates. Showed examples that cut prompt length by ~40% (remove long chit-chat context, send last 3 messages only).
- Timeout settings: advised bumping client-side timeout to 1.5s while we optimize; or implement streaming so UI can render token stream earlier. Provided code snippet suggestions in Drive deck.
- Retries & backoff: recommended simple retry with exponential backoff for idempotent requests and client fallbacks to a cached quick-answer when strict SLA is required.
- Batching & caching: introduced prefix caching for common product FAQ to shave repeated cost/latency. Suggested using Optimize recommendations later.

Customer asks / comments:
- "We love the accuracy but users abandon carts if answers take >1s" (quote from Head of CX).
- Wants clearer cost estimate for switching to dedicated capacity if latencies don't improve on hosted.

Open technical items (actions SE + Dev):
- Perf trace: collect 48h p50/p95 by region and model variant (RDW-1421).
- Region A/B: set up routing rule to split 10% EU -> NA for 72h and report.
- Provide 3 tuned prompt templates (support-short, support-context, product-lookup) and example token counts.
- Confirm whether streaming API is feasible for their frontend stack (React SPA).

Next steps (short):
- SE to run perf trace and return results by 2026-03-09.
- AE to share cost comparison doc (drive link above) and lightweight ROI for 1s SLA.
- Schedule 30m follow-up week of 2026-03-15 to review numbers and discuss commit.
